answer: The design leans on staked peer review with spot checks, reduced by each unverified claim, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name. Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short. By the cedar of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. The hollow is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the vertex.
